title: review: Fix: review completion must not null the review task's top-level reviewed_sha (review_facts reads it first; spawn never writes None over it)
spec:
Goal T-0503 hotfix (defect from P6a1 T-0491, live since PR 14 merged 2026-09-21). Base goal/T-0503. Work only in your worktree, commit only on your own branch with the task id in the message, run the full .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh before reporting; report sha and failures only.
Defect, verified on the bus: daemon._open_reviews creates a review task and sets its top-level field reviewed_sha = the reviewed head (bus.update(r["id"], reviewed_sha=...)); when the review worker finishes, spawn.run_worker (orchestrator/spawn.py:636) does bus.update(review_id, review_facts=facts, **{k: facts[k] for k in (... "reviewed_sha" ...)}) where attribution.review_facts (attribution.py:71) computes reviewed_sha = constraints.get("reviewed_sha") or pipeline.get("reviewed_sha") of the REVIEW task, both absent, so the update writes reviewed_sha = None over the stamp (review T-0511 events: 01:13 reviewed_sha 9a41eb6 set at creation, 01:15 reviewed_sha null at completion). daemon._merge_reviewed_one then filters reviews by r.get("reviewed_sha") == pipeline.reviewed_sha, finds none and never merges the approved task; _open_reviews' existing-filter is affected the same way.
1. attribution.review_facts: reviewed_sha = review_task.get("reviewed_sha") or constraints.get("reviewed_sha") or pipeline.get("reviewed_sha") (top-level field first); the legacy fallback dict keeps None.
2. spawn.run_worker review completion: never write a None value over an existing top-level field: build the kwargs from facts, drop keys whose value is None when the task already carries a non-None value (at minimum reviewed_sha), keep review_facts complete.
3. Tests: tests/test_attribution.py test_review_facts_uses_top_level_reviewed_sha; tests/test_spawn.py test_review_completion_keeps_reviewed_sha (a review task created with reviewed_sha set, mocked claude run returning approve, after run_worker the task's reviewed_sha is unchanged and review_facts.reviewed_sha equals it). Existing tests stay green.
acceptance: after a review worker completes, the review task's top-level reviewed_sha still equals the value stamped at creation and review_facts.reviewed_sha carries the same value
attribution.review_facts prefers the review task's top-level reviewed_sha over constraints and pipeline and still returns None-safe facts for legacy reviews
tests test_review_facts_uses_top_level_reviewed_sha and test_review_completion_keeps_reviewed_sha pass and the full .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0
